title: Inventory movements
description: Full ledger of restocks, write-offs, sales, and other stock changes.

help.title: About stock movements
help.overview: The history of your stock: every change to what's on hand adds a row here, and rows are never changed or removed. Use it to see why a warehouse holds what it holds.

sections.title: Each movement
items: Shows the product, the warehouse, the change (plus in, minus out), the quantity before and after, the reason, who did it and what caused it, such as an order or a transfer.
Reasons: Initial (opening stock), Restock, Sale, Return, Transfer in and out, Adjustment (counts and corrections), Damage and Write-off.
Restocks keep the cost, batch and expiry you entered; write-offs take the cost of the latest delivery, so losses have a value.

sections.title: Changing stock
items: Stock changes on Inventory, Stock transfers and Stock counts, when an order ships, and when a return comes back; never here.
Filter by product, warehouse, reason or date to follow one item.
